description: Filtered live pg_locks/pg_stat_activity evidence of queue-prune versus claim cycle, captured read-only during the private eager saturation benchmark.
capture: One SELECT using MATERIALIZED waiting/involved CTEs; pg_locks and pg_blocking_pids were read without acquiring application locks. This artifact retains only the relevant locks from the full tool output.

processes.query: LOCK TABLE awa.ready_entries_4, awa.ready_claim_attempt_batches_4, awa.done_entries_4, awa.ready_tombstones_4, awa.ready_segments_4, awa.receipt_completion_batches_4, awa.receipt_completion_tombstones_4, awa.queue_terminal_count_deltas_4 IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE

processes.query_prefix_normalized: SELECT ready_slot, ready_generation, lane_seq, enqueue_shard, lease_slot, lease_generation, claim_slot, receipt_id, claim_batch_id, claim_batch_index, job_id, kind, queue, args, lane_priority,

cycle: 151 waits for 295 to release ready_segments_4; 295 waits for 151 to release ready_claim_attempt_batches_4. The prune lock timeout aborts the prune transaction and breaks this cycle.
